name: moderator-unknown
label: The Moderator (wave-2 apex) — unknown
cue: It taps you with the flat of the hammer, almost gentle. Taking your measure.

name: moderator-known
label: The Moderator (wave-2 apex) — known
cue: "REMOVAL NOTICE." The hammer falls — PRIOR VIOLATIONS make it hit +33 harder. (Unavoidable. The mute is the counterplay, not the dodge.) You know this one: Removal Notice locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. It mutes the verb you lean on — strike or move, whichever you use more. Inside the purple field the mute HOLDS: swing or step and your turn is spent, flagged, +3 to its strikes. Step OUT of the field and the verb works again. Vary your verbs to keep the mute chasing the wrong one.
